items.prompt: Portrait of a Hullbreaker, a huge alien hunting beast from a cold heavy-gravity world, hunched forward with the heavy rounded bulk of a great predator: a tall shoulder hump, a thick short neck, a broad barrel body and thick forearms ending in heavy curved claws. A thick coarse shaggy mane of black streaked with grey fur covers the hump, the shoulders, the neck and the back of the head and frames the face; the arms are thick dark leathery hide with coarse hair. The head is low, broad and blunt, sunk into the mane between the shoulders. The face inside the mane is bare, short, blunt and broad, a heavy living face armoured in overlapping matte grey-brown horn plates like a pangolin's scales, dull and dusty, dark leathery skin showing in the creases between them, set low between the shoulders. The jaw is split down the middle of the chin into two plated halves hinged at the sides, the left and right halves closed, meeting in a deep dark seam straight down the middle of the chin. A row of four small glowing amber eyes sits in one straight line across the plated brow, and rows of small dark heat-sensing pits run along the cheeks below them. A scrap armour harness of rusty hull plates from other ships and thick leather straps is strapped across the chest and belly. This is Warlord Grax Ironmaw, the biggest and oldest pack-lord: the tips of both jaw halves capped with old dark iron, harness plates in clashing colours torn from three different fleets, chains across the chest. The head is large in the upper middle of the picture, close to the viewer. Painted grimdark science-fiction character portrait, oil painting with visible loose brushstrokes and palette-knife texture, dramatic chiaroscuro, square composition. Pose and framing: seated on a crude throne welded from hull plates, leaning forward, one claw resting on a heavy boarding hook, half-body view. Setting: a trophy-strewn den aboard his ship, torn hull plates of every faction hung on chains along the walls, painterly and softly out of focus behind the subject. Key light: a red-orange furnace glow from below on the right; deep shadow elsewhere; muted desaturated palette of soot black, rust brown, dried-blood red and a red-orange glow. Museum-quality concept art for a dark space-opera strategy game. No text, no letters, no logo, no border, no frame, no watermark.
